feed.title: Salar Rabbal
feed.subtitle: Forward-looking software engineer with over 10 years of experience in developing substantial software, including the market-leading CDN and a cloud-native ERP for 73,000 customers. Proficient in Go, C#, .NET, JavaScript, NodeJS, TypeScript, Angular, and diverse web technologies. Skilled in system design, architecture, and CI/CD, particularly with Microservices and Micro-Frontends. Emphasizes the importance of clean code, self-testing, and efficient refactoring. Technical leader with a passion for building high-performing teams and driving technical excellence.

entry.title: Purge at Scale
entry.summary: Caching is one of the core components of a CDN. Keeping content close to users reduces latency, lowers origin load, and increases serving capacity. But cached content does not always remain valid until its TTL expires. Sometimes content changes earlier, and the cached copy must be removed explicitly. That is purge.
